label: 2026-11-22-rerun-c
notes: Session accounting: 60 agent sessions (30 tasks x condition C x 10 and 40 turns x 1 repetition), every one graded on its first attempt: no retries (0 of the 5 allowed), no timeouts, no turn-limit hits; the longest took 269 s. Two probe sessions against the mock API (one per repository, condition C) used no model. The none and old C rows are the committed #163 sessions; none of them was re-run.

Binary: myc 0.3.2 built in release mode from d1edc390e0c4 (main with #169, PR #170), sha256 4f59a4b2ada3c7bf701c3f1f28f292ecc0ebee0836926184b86b8af5ef732218. #163 ran 951d041ff9e0 (sha256 4ef9e803...). Claude Code 2.1.330 and the resolved model claude-sonnet-5-5 are the same in both runs.

Indexes built fresh by that binary (myc analyze --strict-embeddings, jina-embeddings-v2-base-code) at the same working paths as #163 (/private/tmp/aeval153/<repo>). Django: the #153/#163 configuration, 12,443 of 12,443 symbols embedded in 1,996 s; index fingerprint (sha256 over the sorted sha256 of its 311 files) 6f63d9000feb4ce5... Vue: the #163 configuration, 15,750 of 15,750 embedded in 3,831 s (built next to the first Django build); 20,566 relationships against #163's 19,544 (#169 resolves the @vue/* workspace packages); fingerprint over 266 files bb68578d8433bbab.... myc callers toRawType now lists 3 direct callers (#163: 0).

Django with tests/: the planned index (myceliums' default configuration, agent_eval.py index --default-config django) parsed 41,842 symbols in 2,956 files with 328,884 relationships and embedded all 41,842 in 8,386 s; community detection then ran for more than 1.5 hours without finishing and the build was stopped (#172). The Django index was rebuilt without tests/, so the #163 confound remains: the primary analysis is the same 27 tasks as in #163, and the 30-task numbers include three Django tests tasks for which C had no index data.

Same setup as #163, checked per session against the #163 run directories: the prompt is byte-identical in all 60 sessions, and the claude command line is identical apart from temporary paths. What setup-claude writes differs only in the routing block, now v3 from #169, with the added line 'Graph answers are heuristic: when completeness matters, or a result says Incomplete or lists calls without an edge, read the source before answering.'

Time drift: the #163 sessions ran 10:34-11:12 UTC on 2026-11-22 (10 and 40 turns), this re-run 20:06-20:24 UTC the same day, not interleaved. A change behind the model alias or in the service between the two would also show up as a C (#171) difference. Two sessions (one per repository) ran at a time, as in #163.
Gold labels of tasks-scale were derived by an agent from the AST and the type checker and are not reviewed by a person (#164 left this set out). One repetition: every task-budget cell is one sample.

Incomplete hints were common: 45 of 60 C sessions received at least one result with an Incomplete block (63 results). The three task-budget pairs C (#171) lost against none: django-flow-runserver-import-string at 10 turns answered from two trace_flow calls although the result said 3 calls got no CALLS edge and named 'read the source at the lines listed above' (not followed; F1 0.48, the same answer as the old C); at 40 turns it read the source after the hint and still missed 8 functions of the exception-handling branch (F1 0.64); vue-amb-reactivity-warn at 40 turns followed the hints and added 22 names (F1 0.68, the old C 0.72); vue-tc-code-frame at 10 turns wrote that it had not checked two unlinked warn call sites and missed 9 functions (F1 0.76).
